assertions.title: Queue loading state

steps.action: Open authenticated sign-in page and log in with the assigned account
steps.expected: Authenticated session reaches the ops surface
steps.observed: Login succeeded and the validator continued on the authenticated email-delivery route.

steps.action: Open /email-delivery?tab=queue&queueFixture=loading and inspect the queue tab immediately after load
steps.expected: A visible loading skeleton or loading copy appears while the queue request is in flight
steps.observed: The queue tab rendered populated KPI tiles and queue content immediately; no visible loading skeleton or loading text was captured.

steps.action: Try deterministic re-entry by toggling tabs and using Refresh
steps.expected: A visible loading state appears during the follow-up fetch
steps.observed: Screenshots from the toggle and refresh attempts still showed settled queue content rather than a visible loading indicator.

evidence.network: Follow-up validator produced screenshot evidence only; no visible queue-loading request state was captured before settled content appeared.
evidence.domEvidence: No screenshot evidence showed 'Loading email queue' or 'Refreshing queued jobs…' text.

assertions.issues: The authenticated queue fixture did not expose a user-visible loading state during the follow-up validation run.

summary: Retested VAL-Q-006 with fresh authenticated evidence, including queue tab re-entry and refresh attempts. The queue surface still rendered settled content immediately, so no visible loading indicator could be confirmed.
